messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] Initiating canary rollout (codename: sprinkle).
env=prod, slice=slice-1 (5%), tag=`v2.7.9-sprinkle`, commit=`c3f4a1e`.
Plan: seed 5% -> quick smoke (2m) -> mini-ramp 25% -> full 100% if metrics stable. UI: <https://deploy.redwood.internal/rl-2026-03-20-1759009999>

alex: ack :thumbsup: watching latency + 5xx across slice-1.

jamie: FYI we had a GC blip on runtime-12 last night. Watch p99 closely — hold if p99 > 200ms for 5m.

sre-ops: setting alert: `canary_errors > 0.5% for 3m` => auto-hold. tagging @oncall.

maria: no DB migrations. This is a model binary swap + runtime flags.

ci-cd-bot: smoke-tests: unit ✅, integration smoke ✅. `smoke: pass`.

deploy-bot: canary seeded to 5% (slice-1). Health snapshot: errors=0.02%, p95=132ms. Next check in 2m.

alex: seeing a couple transient 429s, likely client throttling; increasing retry backoff for canary traffic.

jamie: sending a quick sample from logs:
```
502 from model-runtime-12: kv-cache OOM on batch=16
```
This was one host.

sre-ops: pulling host metrics and restarting runtime-12.

deploy-bot: runtime-12 restarted. Can confirm slice-1 errors down to 0.01%.

deploy-bot: mini-ramp starting -> moving slices to 25% traffic. Tag pinned: `v2.7.9-sprinkle`.

sre-ops: metrics look stable after ramp. p99=198ms, errors=0.03%. ops greenlight :white_check_mark:.

deploy-bot: Full rollout: promoting to 100% traffic now. Rollout id `rl-2026-03-20-1759009999`. Release note short: `v2.7.9-sprinkle` deployed to prod.

maria: I'll update CHANGELOG and push a brief release note to the releases repo.

alex: thanks team. I'll run post-deploy smoke and check canary evals in 1h.

jamie: leaving a note to watch for recurring kv-cache warnings; follow-up ticket created: #INF-4321.
